findings.defect: The publication check and mandatory freshness scan execute before started and deadline are initialized. Their elapsed time is omitted from charged_seconds, and the lease still receives the entire remaining budget. This contradicts the handoff's cumulative cap including setup and permits COMPLETE after the true cumulative wall budget has expired.
findings.evidence: An independent mocked test advanced the synthetic clock by 600 seconds inside freshness(). The terminal receipt reported charged_seconds = 0.0.
findings.required_change: Start cumulative accounting before dispatch setup and subtract elapsed setup from the remaining lease and execution allowance. Preserve that debit in terminal receipts.
findings.title: Mandatory setup time is excluded from the cumulative 16-hour cap

findings.defect: After creating the attempt directory and start export, caffeinate creation, multiprocessing setup, and monitor startup occur outside the receipt-protected try/finally. An OSError from Popen escapes without a terminal receipt. Attempt 1 then exists and cannot be relaunched, while recovery requires the missing verified-stop receipt. A mechanical startup failure therefore cannot use the prepared completion path.
findings.evidence: An independent mocked first-attempt test made Popen raise OSError. The attempt directory remained, but attempt-01/receipt.json.complete was absent. No real subprocess, lease, worker, or Watch session ran.
findings.required_change: Protect startup after attempt creation with cleanup and terminal receipt handling. Record elapsed debit and a verified mechanical stop when no workers remain.
findings.title: Mechanical startup failures strand the attempt without a recovery receipt
